_about: flp_compare_midi thresholds (flh_score). Users override any key with <state folder>/score/compare.json. Timing and velocity words are rules of thumb, not measurements of taste: a human listens to confirm.
_align: MIDI bars are matched to the song by shifts in whole beats; a note counts when a song note of the same key is within one grid step. A bar is found at min_bar_match, or at min_bar_relative x its neighbours' median (never below min_bar_floor).
_channel_fit: with no channels= given, channels where fewer than this share of their notes are near a source note of the same key (added layers: choir, pads, percussion) are left out and listed
